description: This file declares constants, data structures, and function prototypes related to WAN network utilities, including DHCPv6/v4 management, IPv6 address operations, and MAPT configuration.

classes.name: CONTEXT_MARKING_LINK_OBJECT
classes.description: Structure representing a network link object with a found flag.

methods.name: WanManager_StartDhcpv6Client
methods.description: Starts the DHCPv6 client on a specified virtual interface.

methods.name: WanManager_RestartDhcpv6Client
methods.description: Restarts the DHCPv6 client for a given virtual interface and interface type.

methods.name: WanManager_StopDhcpv6Client
methods.description: Stops the DHCPv6 client on a specified virtual interface.

methods.name: WanManager_StartDhcpv4Client
methods.description: Starts the DHCPv4 client on a specified virtual interface.

methods.name: WanManager_StopDhcpv4Client
methods.description: Stops the DHCPv4 client on a specified virtual interface.

methods.name: WanManager_RestartDhcp6c
methods.description: Restarts the DHCPv6 client with specific parameters.

methods.name: WanManager_IsApplicationRunning
methods.description: Checks if a specified application is running.

methods.description: Checks if a process with a given PID is running.

methods.name: isModuleLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a kernel module is loaded.

methods.name: WanManager_DisplayMAPTFeatureStatus

methods.description: Resets MAPT configuration data.

methods.description: Adds an IPv4 gateway route.
